Title: Tennessee Air Quality — Part 2
Content: Photochemical smog is a type of air pollution produced by the emissions of gasoline-powered cars and trucks and can hover over cities as a brown haze. Smog is a mixture of ozone `(text(O)_3)`, nitrogen dioxide `(text(NO)_2)`, nitric oxide `(text(NO))`, and sulfur dioxide `(text(SO)_2)`. `(text(NO)_2)` gas forms in the cylinders of engines when the oxygen gas `(text(O))` and nitrogen gas `(text(N))` are compressed at hot temperatures.
